slice: W215 ordinary JSON actuals at declared Object typed-Dynamic sites
status: VERIFIED within the finite declared scope
claim: Declared Object typed-Dynamic owners compose bound ordinary JSON actual leaves through the existing generic recursive visitor and Object child serializers, including normalized and Wide-part column/table consumers. No codec is added per wrapper product.

admission.binding: Exact field + Dynamic site + canonical actual arm + descriptor-child path binds each ordinary JSON leaf to its ObjectDocumentPlan. Explicit normalized write bindings; physical readers discover persisted child plans. Missing, extra, duplicate and wrong-schema bindings reject.
admission.inherited_context: The same operation budget and absolute descriptor depth cross repeated Object/Dynamic/JSON handoffs. Parent physical P, child logical Q and deeper child occurrence grids remain distinct; physical mark rows retain P and terminal zero.
admission.child_shared_profile: Object-owned JSON shared String serde is single_stream independent of the parent typed String profile. Existing standalone generic Dynamic helper defaults are retained.
admission.selection: JSON-bound values and children validate the complete parent mark domain before selected slicing, including unused children and EOF. Ordinary no-JSON selected reads keep their prior route.
admission.grammar: Legal ClickHouse descriptor grammar only; a base-type codec does not admit an otherwise forbidden wrapper product.
admission.empty_object_depth: An empty advanced Object with no typed fields remains admissible at max_depth=1. Configured typed-root upper bounds apply when typed fields exist; invalid origins and typed-Dynamic minimum origin two remain guarded.
admission.physical_scope: Finite Wide/LZ4 Object composition in single_stream/with_size_stream String profiles and BASIC/COMPACT Dynamic discriminator modes. COMPACT here is a discriminator mode, not the Compact MergeTree part layout.

architecture.reason: Recursive value serde already exists. Specialized nodes must contribute metadata, state, exact physical stream bindings and occurrence-coordinate obligations rather than duplicate a codec for every type product.
